overview: CONST proposes an unsupervised critical instance selection framework for RLVR of LLMs, leveraging procedural volatility, outcome volatility, and conformal prediction to identify lottery-winning samples that achieve comparable performance to full-dataset training with minimal annotation.

modules.name: Data Loading and Preprocessing
modules.description: Load question datasets (BigMath-sub, MMLU calibration subset), parse question-answer pairs, format into standardized structures for training and calibration, and split into training set Q and calibration set D_cal ensuring no overlap.

modules.name: LLM Inference Interface
modules.description: Wrapper for LLM inference supporting deterministic single-output sampling (for procedural volatility), multi-output stochastic sampling (for outcome volatility), and truncated-context re-querying, with token-level control over generation parameters and maximum token limits.

modules.name: Procedural Volatility Computation
modules.description: For each question, deterministically sample a full reasoning trajectory, truncate it at n_P evenly-spaced stages to form a set of partial reasoning paths, then re-query the LLM with each truncated path to directly output a final answer, collecting results into a multiset B_P(X).

modules.name: Outcome Volatility Computation
modules.description: For each question, directly sample n_O outputs from the original policy, extract final answers from each sampled reasoning trajectory, and collect them into a multiset B_O(X) capturing inconsistencies across different reasoning paths.

modules.name: Multiset Merging and Answer Extraction
modules.description: Merge procedural volatility multiset B_P(X) and outcome volatility multiset B_O(X) via multiset union to form B(X), extract unique answers from B(X), and compute frequency counts for each distinct answer within the merged multiset.

modules.name: Scoring Function Implementation
modules.description: Implement the combined scoring function f(X, Y_hat) = f_NF(X, Y_hat) + lambda * f_ent(X, Y_hat), where f_NF is the negative frequency of Y_hat in B(X) and f_ent is the normalized entropy of B(X). Handle the special case where the ground truth answer is absent from B(X) by assigning infinite score.

modules.name: Conformal Prediction Calibration
modules.description: Compute calibration scores over the calibration set D_cal using the scoring function and known ground truth answers, determine the quantile threshold rho_hat at confidence level 1-alpha, and store it for subsequent prediction set generation.

modules.name: Conformal Prediction Set Generation
modules.description: For each question in the training set, compute scores for all candidate answers in B(X) using the scoring function, apply the calibration threshold rho_hat to form the prediction set C_hat(X) containing answers with scores below the threshold, and record the cardinality of each prediction set.

modules.name: Diversity-Aware Sample Selection
modules.description: Embed all questions using Sentence-BERT, partition the question set into b clusters via K-means, and from each cluster select the question with the largest conformal prediction set cardinality to form the critical subset Q_prime, ensuring both informativeness and diversity.

modules.name: Answer Annotation Interface
modules.description: Annotate the selected critical subset Q_prime with ground truth answers A_prime, supporting both manual annotation and automated verification against pre-existing answer keys, producing the final labeled training subset for RLVR optimization.

modules.name: GRPO Loss Function and Optimization Objective
modules.description: Implement the Group Relative Policy Optimization loss with clipped importance ratio, group-relative advantage computation (mean-subtracted and std-normalized rewards within each group), and KL divergence regularization penalty against the reference policy.

modules.name: RLVR Training Loop
modules.description: Orchestrate the full RLVR training pipeline: for each iteration, generate n outputs per question using the current policy, compute verifiable rewards against ground truth, calculate group-relative advantages, update the policy via GRPO loss with gradient accumulation, and evaluate periodically.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics (avg@k)
modules.description: Implement the avg@k accuracy metric: sample k predictions per test question, count matches with ground truth, and compute the average across all test instances. Support dataset-dependent k values (e.g., k=256 for AMC23, k=32 for larger datasets) and repeated runs for variance reduction.

modules.name: Baseline Implementations
modules.description: Implement comparison baselines including RandSelect (random sampling), EntSampling (predictive entropy on sampled outputs), BADGE (diverse uncertain gradient lower bounds with k-means++ seeding), CEC (calibrated entropy-weighted clustering), SCF (self-consistency filtering), and EWS (entropy-weighted sampling).

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Support controlled ablation variants: V1 (replace conformal prediction with random selection per cluster), V2 (remove clustering, select by prediction set size only), V3 (replace conformal prediction sets with entropy for selection), V4 (alternative clustering configuration), V5 (remove procedural volatility), and V6 (remove outcome volatility).

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity and Robustness Analysis
modules.description: Systematically vary procedural volatility stages n_P, outcome volatility samples n_O, calibration set size m, and calibration set source (BigMath vs. MMLU), running full evaluation pipelines for each configuration and aggregating results for comparison tables and plots.
